doc: The eden_game world plus the abi_test package and exports of every argument type: the round-trip guest of the ABI test suite.

exports.name: selftest_run_imports
exports.doc: Calls every import of abi_test and eden_core with known values and checks the answers; returns the number of mismatches.

exports.name: selftest_take_str
exports.doc: Returns the byte length of s plus 1000 * its first byte (0 when empty).

exports.name: selftest_take_bytes
exports.doc: Returns the sum of the bytes of b.

exports.name: selftest_scalars
exports.doc: Returns a + b + c + d + (e ? 1 : 0) as f64.

exports.name: selftest_trap
exports.doc: Calls abi_test.fail, which traps; never returns normally.

exports.name: selftest_bad_pointer
exports.doc: Passes a bad argument to an import: 0 = a str range past linear memory, 1 = bytes with a negative length, 2 = a str holding a NUL byte. Each must trap in the host wrapper.

exports.name: selftest_storage
exports.doc: Exercises eden_storage directly (every error code but ERR_FULL and ERR_IO) and through the libc file modes (w, r, a, remove); leaves the blob `keep` (5 bytes: keep!) behind. Returns the number of mismatches.

exports.name: selftest_blob_size
exports.doc: eden_storage.size of the blob as the guest sees it.

exports.name: selftest_reenter
exports.doc: Calls abi_test.record("reenter"); the host implementation tries to call back into the guest there.

exports.name: selftest_missing
exports.doc: Not implemented by the guest on purpose: an optional export the host must see as absent.
